verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents explicit bank/credit card reconciliation ensuring transactions match statements exactly (puzzle-docs-29), plus AI Close agents that reconcile accounts, review transactions, and surface discrepancies for review (puzzle-docs-24/39). This covers matched/unmatched/discrepancy surfacing, though duplicate-transaction detection specifically is not explicitly called out. Missing for 10: explicit mention of duplicate-transaction detection/flagging, independent/hands-on verification of the reconciliation UI workflow, and detail on how unmatched items are presented for accountant review.
